question: There's a big problem. A huge insect appeared. Please give me the manuscript you just drew so I can roll it up and kill it. Strangler
answer: On no! Here! Hit it hard!! (Bam!!) That was close! Ew, I can clearly see the insect crushed in the manuscript! ... So fill this part with black... there! Imu has appeared!!
name: One-Winged Strangler
